messages:
acme_ops: Hey @support, we've been seeing spikes in latency for our integration since yesterday. p95 jumped ~200ms and traces show requests landing in eu-west instead of us-east. sample trace id: trace-9f3a. Can someone take a look?

alex_support: thanks for the ping — can you paste a raw request/headers (curl) and the Host/edge IP you hit?

acme_ops: curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" -H "Region: US-East" -d '{"input":"hello"}'

acme_ops: we hit edge 34.56.78.90 (us-east LB). but service logs show routed -> eu-west-1.

alex_support: odd. we usually accept header names case-insensitively. attaching to eng-oncall. @todd_oncall can you triage? :eyes:

maria_cs: looping in CS for customer comms. we'll keep them updated.

@todd_oncall: looking now. can you also attach the raw request capture (tcpdump) or proxy logs if you have them? need to see how the header was forwarded.

acme_ops: attaching tcpdump snippet (redacted):

---BEGIN TCPDUMP---
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
authorization: Bearer sk_live_***
region: US_EAST
content-type: application/json
---END TCPDUMP---

acme_ops: note the header name is lowercased and the value shows underscore instead of hyphen when it arrived at our proxy.

jin_router: pinging in — that's suspicious. our router mapping keys are canonicalized as lowercase with hyphens (e.g., us-east). we match exact strings, then fallback to default region if no match. if the ingress changed hyphen to underscore the lookup will fail.

alex_support: where would an underscore substitution happen? that feels like an intermediate proxy or LB rewrite.

acme_ops: we use an older HAProxy build in front of our LB clusters. i've seen docs saying some proxies convert header values' punctuation depending on config.

@todd_oncall: can we repro quickly? acme_ops, can you send a test request with header "X-Debug-Trace: test-underscore" and capture at our edge? also paste the raw header exactly as your client sends it.

acme_ops: our client sends: "Region: US-East" (capitalization as shown).

alex_support: so client sends capitalized hyphen. Proxy/lb seems to lowercase header name (fine) but ALSO normalize the value hyphen -> underscore. that transformation is the problem.

jin_router: confirmed in router logs for trace-9f3a: received region value "US_EAST" -> no match in region_map -> routing fallback to global-eu-pool -> latency jump.

jin_router: quick fix option: make router accept both hyphen and underscore variants (normalize underscores to hyphens) and add a warning metric. will open a PR.

@todd_oncall: creating an incident ticket and assigning to jin. acme_ops — we'll try to deploy a hotfix to the router in staging, then prod with canary. expected impact low but will keep you posted.

deploy-bot: [deploy] build #4521 rolled to canary (router-service) by jin_router — started at 15:22 UTC

maria_cs: thanks, acme_ops. we'll offer to re-run problematic requests after the canary and evaluate any billing/latency impact.

jin_router: PR: normalize region token by replacing '_' with '-' and lowercasing. also added unit tests for mixed-case inputs. will monitor region_mismatch_rate.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary pass — 5k reqs, mismatch rate down from 0.6% -> 0.0%

@todd_oncall: rolling to prod now with 5% traffic, then 50%, then 100%.

deploy-bot: [deploy] prod rollout step 1/3 at 16:05 UTC by jin_router

acme_ops: confirmed from our side — p95 dropped back to expected ~= 40ms for recent traces. thanks for the quick turnaround.

maria_cs: we'll keep monitoring and follow up with a postmortem and suggested mitigations: doc note to customers about header value formats and adding a routing tolerant header parsing doc.

alex_support: action items:
- jin_router: patch/router normalize (in progress)
- eng QA: add e2e test with hyphen/underscore/case variants
- docs: update header format guidance & add troubleshooting quick-checks (maria_cs)
- cs: offer credit review if customer saw billing bump (maria_cs)

acme_ops: appreciate it, team. one request: can we expose a header echo in the response for 24h so we can validate what arrived at the edge? small and helpful for debugging.

@todd_oncall: yes we can add a temporary X-Received-Region echo for debug traces. will enable for your org id for 24h.

acme_ops: perfect, thank you :thumbsup:

alex_support: closing the support thread once prod rollout completes and monitoring is stable.
